headline: Essity Feels Pinch as Consumers Cut Back on Dining Out
summary: Paper towel maker Essity reported feeling pressure as consumer habits shift and Americans reduce spending on dining out.
why: Consumer goods manufacturers rely on steady away-from-home demand across restaurants and hospitality sectors for volume growth.

impacts.name: Essity AB
impacts.why: Reduced out-of-home dining lowers commercial demand for paper products and hygiene supplies.
